This release adds experimental **Story So Far** for EPUB books: short AI recaps of completed chapters, with the entire current chapter excluded and saved recaps available offline. It uses the actual book text, uploads only the required compressed files, and reuses a bounded multi-book cache so later recaps send only missing content. The public service is included in firmware, with no personal API key or manual SD setup required. A single confirmation, clear progress stages, page navigation, retry actions and quota messages keep the flow simple. This release also fixes returning from the Hardcover menu accidentally exiting the book and improves TLS certificate compatibility.

**Notes:** New recaps require Wi-Fi and share the service's provider quota. Story So Far is EPUB-only, depends on supported chapter boundaries, and AI can make mistakes. Use it only for books you are entitled to process. See the [Story So Far guide](https://github.com/StefanTsonev/CrossCover/blob/main/docs/story-so-far.md) for privacy and service limits.

Firmware: `firmware-x3-x4-v1.6.1-crosscover.3.bin`; Xteink X3/X4 only; do not flash USB-locked devices.
